title: Activity brings usage and transactions together
summary:
Activity now puts filtered API usage, transactions, and app earnings in one place—and stops rounding tiny Pollen amounts into oblivion.

Activity now pairs an API usage chart with a transaction table. Shared period, API key, and model filters let people inspect both views together; the table replaces the separate recent-transactions section on the Pollen page.

App earnings are now an always-visible Activity section, with the earnings setting using the same name. Usage and earnings also have empty states specific to the selected period.

Activity charts and totals show small nonzero Pollen amounts more precisely instead of rounding them to zero. CSV downloads explain when they are unavailable because data is loading or the selected period has nothing to export.

highlights.title: Explore your API activity
highlights.text: Compare API usage and transactions in Activity with shared period, API key, and model filters. App earnings have their own always-visible section.
